title: Reach recipes registry index
description: The shape of recipes.json. Generated by build-index.mjs — do not hand-edit the index; edit the recipe and regenerate, or the sha256 goes stale and every install of that recipe fails.

id.description: Stable identifier. Becomes the filename on disk, so it must not contain a path separator.

version.description: Semver. Bump it whenever the script changes.

description.description: One line, shown under the name and above the run button.

repo.description: owner/name, for the Source link. Informational.

targets.description: Distros the author wrote this for. Advisory: nothing checks it, because guessing wrong and refusing to run would be worse than letting someone decide for themselves.

danger.description: What the author declares. Reach analyses the script independently and shows the user when the two disagree.

url.description: Direct link to the .sh file. Must be https.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the bytes at url. Verified before anything is written to disk; a mismatch fails the install. This is what makes the maintainer's review mean something.
